title: LU Factorization
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/LU_Factorization.md
text: Factor square matrix into lower and upper triangular components, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Show singularity status}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.
